contact_model_note: Rigid point-contact baseline, matching default PhysX collision schema and Office mesh colliders. Explicitly override FixedCuboid's 1.0/0.8 m torsional patch defaults. Preserve ordinary friction and solid floor/threshold geometry. Finite foot-patch sensitivity is separate; no real contact calibration is claimed.
scope: Engineering simulation controller gate. Does not qualify joint-level deployment on a physical robot. Threshold crossing must be witnessed, not inferred from spawning a barrier.
